input: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products in production (scheduled ventures prompt)

errors.what: A seeded-fault check (sed on decide-core.mjs, then restore) ran in the same command that launched a background sweep, so the sweep imported the mutated engine; its targeted rows were wrong. Caught because round-robin rows matched the earlier run exactly and targeted rows did not; the sweep was discarded and rerun.
errors.fix: Never mutate a module while a background process may be importing it; run mutation checks on a copy or after background jobs start fully.

errors.what: Duplicate work: another session's PR 15979 landed the same feature (site/decide.html, decide-core.mjs, DECIDE-PAGE.md, same file names) while this PR was open; the merge conflicted on every file. My claim PR (15977, draft, titled with the slug) was open first, so either the other session did not run claim_check or the claim was not visible to it.
errors.fix: Dropped this session's own page (its first version stays in the PR history), reset the branch to main and ported the two pieces main's page lacked: a winner stop with a leader-focused picker, and exact what-would-change-the-winner weights; re-measured on main's own simulated people.

doc_friction.issue: The pkill hook rule is documented ('bracket the first letter') but the hook also rejects a bracketed pattern when the unbracketed word appears elsewhere in the same command line; cost one retry.
venture-preflight.mjs took well over 5 min here (main_health repository checks under CPU contention from simulation sweeps); worth noting it competes for the 4 cores with any sweep.

deviations.why: The quick-pick-survey next list ranks (r) distribution and (c) real survey answers first; both need visitor data or real respondents this session cannot get. Its remaining buildable items (d11, d8) are fine-grained simulation refinements of an already deeply measured rank engine.
deviations.did: Built a new user-facing surface in the same venture instead: a weighted decision matrix (multi-criteria) page from pairwise picks, with a measured targeted question picker, and added it to next: as item (m).
deviations.result: Page live on merge; median picks to stop halved for 5x3 vs asking in turn on simulated people.

deviations.why: 'A conflict is not a reason to close: merge main in and resolve it.' A mechanical merge would have shipped two engines for one page.
deviations.did: Consolidated instead: kept main's engine and page, ported the measured improvements, rewrote the post about the overlap.
deviations.result: One page; winner stop + focus: true best 35/60 vs 31, 8% fewer picks, 13 vs 19 big misses.

goal: Make the multi-criteria decision page stop when the winner is settled, and say what would change the winner.
notes: Final diff on top of PR 15979's page: decisionTable.safe + DECIDE_MARGIN 0.25; decisionDone winner rule; nextQuestion focus 'winner' (default) vs 'order'; whatWouldChange; page status/verdict/weights column. Verification: node --test ventures/quick-pick-survey/site/*.test.mjs 73/73 (decide-core 12/12; forcing safe=1 turns the winner-stop test red); scripts/decide-stop-sweep.mjs on decide-sim's 60 people (docs/decide-winner-stop-2026-11-14.jsonl, docs/decide-order-focus-stop-2026-11-14.jsonl); decide-sim.mjs rerun with winner focus (docs/decide-sim-winner-focus-2026-11-14.jsonl); Playwright 390px: example stops at 45 picks (cap 72), no console errors, no horizontal scroll; check_md_links and check_post_frontmatter ok. The first, separate-page version (own 0-100 aggregation, 88-person sweeps) is in this PR's earlier commits only.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: engine/picker derivation, two sweeps, consolidation onto main's page, write-up; senior engineer estimate

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
